evidence: Nestled in the heart of Vạn Phúc Ward, Hà Đông District, the Van Phuc Pagoda stands as a serene oasis amidst the bustling silk village. This ancient pagoda, bearing the name "Vạn Phúc" which conveys sincere aspirations for myriad blessings and eternal peace, has accompanied the ups and downs of the capital land for many centuries.

This ancient pagoda, bearing the name "Vạn Phúc" which conveys sincere aspirations for myriad blessings and eternal peace, has accompanied the ups and downs of the capital land for many centuries. The pagoda's rustic tam quan structure, with its dark brown wooden columns and moss-covered ngói mũi hài roof, immediately catches the eye, while the exquisitely carved bell tower soaring gracefully in the front courtyard serves as a unique highlight.
